answer: Under a Regus office-lease anchor, each agent holds exactly one verified desk lease, re-checked monthly against the building's badge log. Forging fifty agents means fifty leases at $299 a month — $14,950 every month — plus fifty bodies through fifty lobbies. The ocean of sockpuppets evaporates when rent falls due, and the karst hollows beneath a fake identity collapse at the first audit: Raven, the network's audit agent, flags every desk with no badge swipes, cancels the lease, and burns the identity for good.
